description: Change passwords on behalf of the user (using the 'password changer' feature)

bulk_change_credential_count.description: It has been deprecated because we removed the Password Changer feature from all clients in October 2022.The number of credentials selected as part of a password changer bulk change.

change_master_password_error.description: An error returned when creating, changing, or resetting a master password.

is_bulk_change.description: It has been deprecated because we removed the Password Changer feature from all clients in October 2022. If the user has launched password changer on multiple compatible credentials at the same time (click on Change X or Change All)

is_credential_currently_eligible_to_pass.description: It has been deprecated because we removed the Password Changer feature from all clients in October 2022. If the user has the ability to change his credential with password changer on a specific date.

last_recipe_step_position.description: It has been deprecated because we removed the Password Changer feature from all clients in October 2022. The step of the recipe process at which the password changer attempt ended. It is important to note that the meaning of a step number depends on the domain recipe (step 8 might not mean the same for 2 distinct recipes)

password_changer_failure_reason.description: It has been deprecated because we removed the Password Changer feature from all clients in October 2022. The reason that caused the failure of a password changer attempt.

password_changer_recipe_version.description: It has been deprecated because we removed the Password Changer feature from all clients in October 2022. The version of the recipe built for a specific domain

update_credential_origin.description: Where the credential edition or addition is coming from
